report_name: Major US Law Firms Report Data Breaches Exposing SSNs

threat_actors.name: Unidentified Social Engineering Attacker
threat_actors.description: An unidentified attacker who used social engineering to gain remote access to Holland & Knight's systems, leading to the exfiltration of files related to 14 clients.

threat_actors.name: Unidentified Third-Party Attacker
threat_actors.description: An unidentified third party that obtained a limited set of information, including Social Security numbers, from the law firm Squire Patton Boggs.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Assessed as the likely social engineering vector used to gain initial access to Holland & Knight's network, possibly through a malicious link or attachment.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: An attacker used legitimate credentials, stolen via social engineering, to gain remote access to Holland & Knight's systems.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: An attacker leveraged a remote access capability to connect to a computer at Holland & Knight after obtaining valid credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: After accessing sensitive files at Holland & Knight, the attacker exfiltrated them, potentially using encrypted channels or common protocols to blend in with normal traffic.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: Encoded PowerShell commands were noted as a hunting hint for detecting attacker activity after initial access, such as downloading additional tools or executing commands.

identities.name: Holland & Knight LLP
identities.description: A major global law firm that disclosed a data breach resulting from a social engineering attack. The incident led to unauthorized remote access and the compromise of files containing sensitive data for 14 clients.

identities.name: Squire Patton Boggs LLP
identities.description: A major global law firm that reported a data breach on October 8, 2026, where an unauthorized party obtained a limited set of information, including the Social Security numbers of at least two Vermont residents.

indicators.name: Encoded PowerShell Command Line Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Encoded PowerShell Command Line Execution
id: 2b5d7e3f-1c9a-4b8d-9f6e-7a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of encoded PowerShell commands, which are frequently used by attackers after initial access to download additional tools or execute commands obfuscated from command line logging.
references:
  - https://cybernews.com/news/us-law-firms-hit-by-data-breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-10
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' -enc '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of encoded PowerShell commands, a common technique for attackers to obfuscate their actions after gaining initial access.
